stories.title: Wales survey: one in two ten and eleven year olds on social media each week
stories.summary: Half of ten and eleven year olds in Wales are using social media regularly, according to the largest survey of primary school children’s health and wellbeing ever carried out in the country. stories.title: Welsh Government consults on leaseholder protections under new building safety law
stories.summary: The Welsh Government is consulting on how to put into practice new laws designed to stop leaseholders in Wales being billed for building safety failures they did not cause. stories.title: New Welsh Government announces £145 million for NHS Wales waiting times
stories.summary: The Welsh Government has announced £145 million in extra funding for NHS Wales this financial year, with waiting times named as the immediate target. stories.title: Met Office forecast points to heatwave for Flintshire
stories.summary: Temperatures in Deeside are set to climb through the weekend and into next week, reaching a forecast 27°C on Monday.
